raw.rationale: SAR-245409 is a PI3K/mTOR inhibitor whose single 2.5 µM 5-day PRISM profile would likely show only weak, non-lineage-specific cytotoxicity, with modest enrichment possible in PIK3CA-mutant breast and other PI3K-pathway-dependent lineages. Published PRISM/CTRP data for PI3K inhibitors generally show low selective-lineage rates, so probabilities are kept near the 0.2–2.5% base rate with slight elevation for breast and gynecologic lineages.
